spec.description: A post with its ancestors and replies.

request.title: GetPostThreadRequest
request.description: Which post and how much of its thread.

uri.description: AT URI of the post, such as `at://did:plc:z72i7hdynmk6r22z27h6tvur/app.bsky.feed.post/3kxyz...`.

depth.description: How many levels of replies to include. Range [0, 1000]; defaults to 6.

parentHeight.description: How many ancestors to include. Range [0, 1000]; defaults to 80.

response.title: PostThread
response.description: The thread around the requested post.

thread.title: Thread
thread.description: The requested post with its context, or a marker that it is gone or blocked.

threadgate.description: The thread's reply gate, when the root has one (`app.bsky.feed.defs#threadgateView`). Kept as a map.

additionalProperties.description: A field of the threadgate view.

notes: Written from the `app.bsky`/`com.atproto` lexicons as remembered, not read: the docs host was unreachable. The schema is a subset of the lexicon; undeclared fields pass validation and are dropped from the validated value. The first recording confirms or corrects it.

The thread is recursive on the wire (`parent` and `replies` hold the same shape as `thread`). The schema types the root and one level around it; a validated result drops `parent`/`replies` below that level. `validate=False` returns the whole tree.
